        "post_date": "2026-10-29T16:04:25.990Z",
        "raw_markdown": "Based on some probing, we're quite convinced things are not back to normal, and more specifically all our submission are losing ~40 minutes.\n\nMore details:\n- The model comes up at normal speed counted from notebook start (since switching the checkpoints to models rather than datasets). We know this, because we error out the submission if it doesn't, and our submissions don't error out based on this (anymore).\n- However, the notebook itself starts only ~40 minutes after the container starts. We know this, because if we add an additional error that stops if /proc/uptime is over 20 minutes on start, the notebook errors out consistently (~40 minutes after submitting it). This could be attching datasets, but we don't know.\n- These 40 minutes count against submission. We know this, because our successful submissions (without the /proc/uptime killswitch) run for 9 hours, not 9 hours and 40 minutes.",
        "content": "\u003cp\u003eBased on some probing, we're quite convinced things are not back to normal, and more specifically all our submission are losing ~40 minutes.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eMore details:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eThe model comes up at normal speed counted from notebook start (since switching the checkpoints to models rather than datasets). We know this, because we error out the submission if it doesn't, and our submissions don't error out based on this (anymore).\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eHowever, the notebook itself starts only ~40 minutes after the container starts. We know this, because if we add an additional error that stops if /proc/uptime is over 20 minutes on start, the notebook errors out consistently (~40 minutes after submitting it). This could be attching datasets, but we don't know.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eThese 40 minutes count against submission. We know this, because our successful submissions (without the /proc/uptime killswitch) run for 9 hours, not 9 hours and 40 minutes.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e",
